channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: Report: US strikes Iranian tankers after missile attacks on Navy warship
item.description: A US official says US forces struck Iranian tankers linked to the IRGC after attempted missile attacks on a US Navy ship. Iran warns crews near Kuwait and Bahrain.

item.title: Watch: Ambassador and Knesset Speaker get the crowd dancing
item.description: At an event marking the US 250th anniversary, Ambassador Huckabee and Knesset Speaker Ohana take the stage, play American hits and invite the crowd to dance.

item.title: Hostage's mother sues haredi provocateur
item.description: Haredi provocateur Dov Halbertal claimed that Iris Haim was planning to enter politics “on her son’s blood." Her attorneys have filed a lawsuit seeking approximately NIS 170,000.

item.title: Quentin Tarantino: From honorary Israeli to cinema nuisance?
item.description: The legendary director has long been a familiar face in Israel. But according to several moviegoers, Tarantino may now have acquired a new reputation: the guy you really don't want sitting in front of you at the cinema.

item.description: Real colonizers don’t pay retail.

item.description: Minister Sa’ar speaks with UK Opposition Leader Kemi Badenoch and Shadow Foreign Secretary Tom Tugendhat, thanks them for opposing British government’s latest measures

item.title: UAE refuses to comment on report it warned about October 7
item.description: The UAE government would not confirm or deny that President Mohammed bin Zayed warned Netanyahu about a Hamas attack in September 2023.

item.title: Driver alert: Police to launch special traffic enforcement operation tomorrow
item.description: Increased forces, drones, and advanced technological equipment will be deployed across the country on Wednesday, as part of a wide-ranging traffic enforcement operation by the Traffic Division.

item.description: From right and left to the Ten Commandments: The new party seeks to 'put the puzzle together.'

item.title: Rabbi Ephraim Mirvis: 'A dark day for British Jews'
item.description: Chief Rabbi Ephraim Mirvis condemns British government sanctions targeting Jews in Judea and Samaria, warning they will bolster extremism and fuel an increasingly hostile discourse against Israel.

item.title: When the sting becomes sweet
item.description: Lessons learned from the bee whose honey is a symbol of a sweet new year.

item.title: Last minute drama in United Torah Judaism party
item.description: Porush, Belz representative announce new party within united list, seeking independent control over budgets and political decision-making.

item.title: Rubio: No announcements yet on UK Judea and Samaria sanctions
item.description:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio was asked about the UK sanctions on Jewish communities in Judea and Samaria.
He stated: "They alerted us to it. We don't have any announcements. Obviously, those are decisions that they make, and we and the President have expressed this in the past. We don't want to see anything destabilizing going on right now in the West Bank with so much going on in the region. We think it has implications as well on our ability to make progress with regards to Gaza and the 20-point plan and the border peace that we're very committed to. Obviously, we're not going to do what the UK did. We saw their announcement today, but I don't have any comment on it right now."

item.title: The fruit that never falls alone
item.description: The shomer, Rabbi Soloveitchik posited, offers a way of understanding those who guard a human being through the stages of life: a parent, a rebbe, and ultimately the Ribbono Shel Olam.

item.title: Terror cell that planned attack in Modi’in exposed
item.description: More than 30 terrorists were arrested by the Shin Bet, IDF and police on suspicion of involvement in the terrorist infrastructure - some had been released in one of the hostage deals.

item.title: Israel bans 12 British leaders from entering country
item.description:
Following the imposition of sanctions on Judea and Samaria, Israel decided to ban 12 British leaders and citizens from entering its territory.
Among the individuals whose entry will be banned is Jeremy Corbyn, former leader of the British Labor Party.

item.title: Israel's response to UK - closing British Consulate in Jerusalem
item.description: Foreign Minister Sa’ar announces closure of British Consulate in Jerusalem and other countermeasures against UK sanctions.

item.title: Requiem for Charlie Kirk: More than a memory.
item.description: It is the fate of heroes who take up the quest to return society to its values to often find a path destined for martyrdom.Op-ed.

item.title: We remember 9/11 but ignore its lessons
item.description: US security agencies, until 1991, monitored the communist threat, but largely ignored the growing Islamist and globalist threats. The US still does not fight Islamit threat the way it should. Opinion.

item.title: Slovenian Deputy PM: “There should be sovereignty in Samaria"
item.description: On the day Britain announced sanctions against Judea and Samaria, Samaria Regional Council head Yossi Dagan held an extended diplomatic meeting in Slovenia with the deputy prime minister.

item.title: UK Jewish leaders condemn ban on Israeli settlement imports
item.description: Jewish Leadership Council accuses the UK government of putting a “target on British Jews" by banning imports from Israeli settlements, while rights groups welcome the move and call for further action against Israel.

item.title: October 7 hero who was seriously wounded appointed Brigade Commander
item.description: Col. Guy Madar, who was wounded in the battles of October 7 and was nearly mistakenly shot until he was identified by his tzitzit, has assumed command of the Yoav Brigade.

item.title: Head of Efrat Council: "Someone in London got confused"
item.description:
The head of the Efrat Council, Dovi Shefler, responded to Britain's intention to boycott products from Judea and Samaria.
"The British Mandate ended in May 1948 - someone in London probably got confused and thinks it is still in effect. Our answer should be to return all of Prikot Shlom to Israeli control," said Scheffler.

item.title: Lapid: British sanctions on Israel a serious mistake and encouragement to Hamas
item.description: Former Prime Minister Yair Lapid has attacked the British government's decision to impose boycotts and sanctions on Israel. He said it is a "wrong and dangerous policy" that will strengthen extremist voices in Israel ahead of the elections and encourage Hamas and terrorist organizations. Lapid claimed that the decision stems from domestic political considerations in Britain.

item.title: UK: Hamas cannot play a role in the future government in Gaza and must disarm
item.description: British Foreign Secretary Miliband said that Israel has the right to live without fear of threats from a terrorist regime, but that this does not justify what happened in Gaza. He added that some 70,000 people have been killed in the Strip, including, according to him, 20,000 children.

item.title: Opposition figures demand investigation over Oct. 7 revelations
item.description: Gadi Eisenkot, Naftali Bennett, Avigdor Liberman and Yair Golan issue joint statement calling for investigation following report that the UAE President warned Netanyahu over a week before October 7.
